letter.intro: I’m Mike, and I write mobile apps, mostly in Flutter and Kotlin. I spent a little over two years on Flutter at atFirstSite, then two years on native Android at Deloitte, working on three retail e-commerce apps in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. These days I also run web accessibility assessments there.
letter.apps: In my own time I build small apps, slowly. {healpen} is a journal for expressive writing that encrypts your entries on the phone before they sync. {peakward} is a running app that builds training plans from HealthKit data. {budgetCoach} keeps a budget with a daily check-in and a weekly review, and {localmind} runs a language model on the phone, so nothing leaves it. They’re all in beta on TestFlight, so if you have an iPhone, join in.
letter.tools: {famon} is an open-source command-line tool that streams Firebase Analytics events from Android and iOS device logs while you debug. {efimeries} is a web app that builds fair on-call schedules for doctors in Greek public hospitals. And {site} is one of them too: I publish it from a small admin I built for it.
letter.writing: Now and then I {write} about what I’m building and what I learn along the way.
letter.contact: If you’re working on an app and want a hand, or just want to talk Flutter or Android, {contact}⁠. It’s {time} here in Heraklion, so allow for the time difference. I usually reply within a few days.
